D072: the blocker is a rating-input limitation, not a missing document: the ratings context carries only an ambient temperature, while GL41 Fig. 1 derates against terminal temperature. Closing needs a terminal-temperature input or an owner decision; deriving terminal temperature from two typical thermal resistances is not proposed.
